collection.title: Mercedes-Benz AMG GT Roadster 2015 to 2023 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a Mercedes-Benz AMG GT 2015 to 2023 model which requires a 20" wiper blade on both the drivers side and the passengers side. This model uses the Side Pin wiper arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
